Python with multiple imports, verify imports contain specific source

```java title="Java"
import io.xberg.treesitterlanguagepack.*;

public final class Example {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        var configJson = "{\"language\":\"python\"}";
        var config = JsonUtil.fromJson(configJson, ProcessConfig.class);
        var result = TreeSitterLanguagePack.process("import os\nimport sys\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\ndef main():\n    pass\n", config);
        System.out.println(result.language());
        System.out.println(result.imports());
        System.out.println(result.imports().get(0).source());
    }
}
```
